title: Payoff and Title Desk Schedule for Retail Installment Contracts: Quote Validity, Funds Clearance and Lien Release
content:
These figures are the same at every tier of Retail Installment Contracts, Tier 6 Fresh Start through Tier 1 Select.

## Payoff quote validity

A payoff quote is good through the quote date plus **10** calendar days, the quote date counting as day 0.

## Funds clearance by payment channel

Payoff funds become final this many business days after posting (business days are Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays):

| Paying channel | Business days until funds are final |
|---|---|
| recurring autopay draft | 10 |
| one-time bank draft through the phone line, website or app | 10 |
| one-time bank draft taken by a live representative | 10 |
| debit card through the phone line, website or app | 3 |
| debit card through a live representative | 3 |
| MoneyGram | 1 |
| mailed personal check | 10 |
| wire transfer | 0 |
| certified funds (cashier's check or money order) | 0 |
| third-party remittance (insurer, auction or other third party) | 0 |

## Lien release

The lien is released no later than **10** business days after the funds-final date.

The release is electronic in these title states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NJ, NV, NY, OH, PA, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI. In every other title state the paper title is mailed by first-class mail.

**Hypothetical timing.** A payoff by debit card posted on a Monday with no holiday that week becomes final on Thursday, three business days later; the release is then due no later than ten business days after that Thursday. A payoff by wire is final on its posting date.
